title: Two Sum
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers that add up to target.

options.title: Brute Force
options.description: Double loop comparing every pair O(n²)
options.explanation: Works, but times out on large inputs. Too slow!

options.title: Hash Map Complement
options.description: Store seen numbers in hash map, check for target - num in O(1)
options.explanation: Optimal! Runs in O(n) time and O(n) space.

options.title: Binary Search
options.description: Binary search for every complement
options.explanation: Requires sorting first O(n log n), which messes up original indices.

options.title: Bitmasking
options.description: Bitwise AND pairs together
options.explanation: Bit manipulation cannot calculate arithmetic sums directly here.

pseudoHint: Use a hash map to store seen numbers and their indices, then check if (target - num) is in the map.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

options.title: Sliding Window + Set
options.description: Expand right pointer; shrink left pointer while duplicate exists
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time using a sliding window and character set.

options.title: Sort & Count
options.description: Sort characters and count unique ones
options.explanation: Sorting destroys substring contiguity.

options.title: All Substrings
options.description: Generate every substring and check uniqueness
options.explanation: O(n³) or O(n²) brute force is too slow.

options.title: Binary Search
options.description: Binary search on character ASCII values
options.explanation: ASCII values have no monotonic property for substrings.

pseudoHint: Maintain a left pointer and a set of characters in the current window.

title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Given a string s containing just '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

options.title: Counter Variables
options.description: Count opening and closing brackets
options.explanation: Fails on interleaved invalid orders like '([)]'.

options.title: LIFO Stack
options.description: Push opening brackets, pop and match on closing brackets
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time and O(n) space!

options.title: Two Pointers
options.description: Compare characters from both ends inward
options.explanation: Fails on sequential pairs like '()[]'.

options.title: Hash Map Only
options.description: Check if total frequencies are even
options.explanation: Order matters, not just frequency.

pseudoHint: Push opening brackets onto a stack; on a closing bracket, pop and verify it matches.

title: Container With Most Water
statement: Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water.

options.title: Two Pointers (Move Shorter)
options.description: Start at ends, move the shorter height pointer inward
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time and O(1) space. Moving the taller line can never increase area.

options.title: Sort Heights
options.description: Sort heights and multiply top two
options.explanation: Sorting loses the horizontal distance between lines.

options.title: All Pairs
options.description: Check every pair (i, j) in O(n²)
options.explanation: Times out on large arrays.

options.title: Sliding Window Fixed
options.description: Use a fixed-width window
options.explanation: Width is variable, not fixed.

pseudoHint: Start left=0, right=n-1. Compute area, then advance whichever pointer has the smaller height.

title: Maximum Subarray
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

options.title: Kadane's Algorithm
options.description: Reset running sum to 0 whenever it drops below 0
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time and O(1) space!

options.title: Sort & Sum Positives
options.description: Sum all positive numbers
options.explanation: Subarray must be contiguous.

options.title: Two Pointers
options.description: Shrink from ends
options.explanation: Negative numbers break greedy two-pointer shrinking.

options.title: Prefix Sum Matrix
options.description: Check all (i, j) prefix differences
options.explanation: O(n²) is too slow.

pseudoHint: Track current_sum; if current_sum < 0, reset it to 0 before adding the next number.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
statement: Given a rotated sorted array nums and a target, return its index in O(log n) time, or -1 if not found.

options.title: Linear Scan
options.description: Loop through array from start to end
options.explanation: O(n) violates the O(log n) requirement.

options.title: Modified Binary Search
options.description: Identify which half is sorted, then check if target lies inside it
options.explanation: Optimal O(log n) time and O(1) space.

options.title: Sort First
options.description: Re-sort array then binary search
options.explanation: O(n log n) is too slow and loses original indices.

options.title: Hash Map
options.description: Build value-to-index map
options.explanation: Building the map takes O(n) time and O(n) space.

pseudoHint: Check if nums[left] <= nums[mid] (left half sorted), then decide which half contains target.

title: Reverse Linked List
statement: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.

options.title: Copy to Array
options.description: Store values in array, reverse, rebuild list
options.explanation: Uses O(n) extra space unnecessarily.

options.title: Iterative prev/curr Pointers
options.description: Flip curr.next to prev while advancing both pointers
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time and O(1) space.

options.title: Bubble Swap Values
options.description: Swap node values from ends
options.explanation: O(n²) in a singly linked list.

options.title: Hash Map
options.description: Map each node to its predecessor
options.explanation: Unnecessary O(n) memory.

pseudoHint: Save curr.next, point curr.next to prev, then advance prev = curr and curr = saved_next.
pythonSolution:
def reverseList(head):
    prev, curr = None, head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    return prev

title: Invert Binary Tree
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree (mirror it), and return its root.

options.title: Swap Left & Right Recursively
options.description: Swap root.left and root.right, then recurse on both children
options.explanation: Clean O(n) time and O(h) recursion stack.

options.title: Inorder Sort
options.description: Collect inorder traversal and reverse it
options.explanation: Does not preserve tree structure.

options.title: Swap Leaves Only
options.description: Only swap leaf nodes
options.explanation: Internal subtrees must be mirrored too.

options.title: Binary Search
options.description: Search for target nodes
options.explanation: Not a search problem.

pseudoHint: If root is null return null; swap root.left and root.right, then invert both subtrees.
pythonSolution:
def invertTree(root):
    if not root:
        return None
    root.left, root.right = root.right, root.left
    invertTree(root.left)
    invertTree(root.right)
    return root

title: Number of Islands
statement: Given an m x n 2D grid of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.

options.title: Count All '1's
options.description: Return total number of '1' cells
options.explanation: Connected '1's form a single island.

options.title: DFS / BFS Flood Fill
options.description: On each '1', increment count and sink connected land to '0'
options.explanation: Optimal O(m * n) time!

options.title: Row-wise Scan
options.description: Count contiguous '1' segments per row
options.explanation: Misses vertical connections between rows.

options.title: Binary Search
options.description: Binary search for '1's
options.explanation: Grid is not sorted.

pseudoHint: Loop over grid; when you see '1', increment islands and run DFS/BFS to mark all connected '1's as '0'.

title: Single Number
statement: Every element in nums appears twice except for one. Find that single one in O(1) extra space.

options.title: Hash Map Frequency
options.description: Count frequencies in a hash map
options.explanation: Uses O(n) extra space, violating O(1) space.

options.title: XOR All Elements
options.description: Initialize res = 0 and XOR every number; pairs cancel out
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time and O(1) space!

options.title: Sort & Scan
options.description: Sort array and check adjacent pairs
options.explanation: Takes O(n log n) time.

options.title: Sum All Elements
options.description: Add all numbers together
options.explanation: Sum doesn't isolate the unique number without a set.

pseudoHint: Initialize res = 0, then do res = res ^ num for every num in nums.

title: Climbing Stairs
statement: You are climbing a staircase of n steps. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. How many distinct ways can you reach the top?

options.title: Rolling Two Variables (Fibonacci)
options.description: ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2) using two variables
options.explanation: Optimal O(n) time and O(1) space!

options.title: Pure Recursion
options.description: Call climb(n-1) + climb(n-2) without memoization
options.explanation: O(2^n) exponential time.

options.title: Divide by 2
options.description: Return n // 2 + 1
options.explanation: Underestimates combinations.

options.title: Factorial
options.description: Compute n!
options.explanation: Overcounts because step order is constrained.

pseudoHint: Keep two variables one=1, two=1 and iterate n-1 times: temp = one + two, two = one, one = temp.

title: Merge Intervals
statement: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals.

options.title: Sort by Start & Merge
options.description: Sort intervals by start time, then merge if next.start <= prev.end
options.explanation: Optimal O(n log n) time!

options.title: Hash Map of Points
options.description: Mark every integer point in a map
options.explanation: Fails on large ranges or continuous intervals.

options.title: Two Pointers Unsorted
options.description: Compare adjacent intervals without sorting
options.explanation: Overlapping intervals may not be adjacent.

options.title: Stack Only
options.description: Push all intervals to stack
options.explanation: Requires sorting first.

pseudoHint: Sort by start; if current start <= last merged end, update last merged end = max(last_end, current_end).
